entry.title: A valid signature is not a valid login
entry.summary: authentik verified a SAML assertion's signature and lifetime without proving it was meant for that SAML Source or tied to its login request. Because accepted assertions were not remembered, a valid assertion could also be replayed.

entry.title: Panic recovery stays local
entry.summary: PocketBase recovered panics during ordinary request handling, but work moved into child goroutines lived beyond that boundary. A reachable panic could terminate the server instead of becoming a regular error.

entry.title: Revocation must reach every live stream
entry.summary: ntfy removed a user's access or account, but its teardown helper stopped after cancelling the first matching subscription. Other live streams could continue receiving that topic's messages until they disconnected.

entry.title: When identity data becomes policy syntax
entry.summary: Moquette inserted client IDs and usernames directly into pattern-based ACL rules. MQTT wildcard characters in those identities could broaden a tenant-scoped rule and grant cross-tenant read or write access.
